AccelerationTuningNote.value: Launch* controls 0-14 MPH; PowerBand* controls where tiered pull fades; AerodynamicDrag* controls high-speed resistance.

BoostTuningNote.value: Duration/Recharge min/max seconds are physical bounds; raw V2 boost stats still determine position within them.

DriftTuningNote.value: DriftGrip reduces boat-like slide; EngineAssist and VelocityAlignment pull momentum around the corner; SideForce creates rotation.

HandlingTuningNote.value: SteeringResponse min/max multipliers compress E-S steering without changing rating stats.

OrganisedTuningNote.value: Select one category Folder and edit its numeric Attributes. Each matching _RaisingThisDoes string explains the higher-value effect.

Phase2TuningNote.value: Disable HandlingEnabled to keep Phase 1 longitudinal dynamics with legacy handling/drift behavior.

Phase2_1TuningNote.value: Full drift uses Base + BlendExtra. Old slowdown was 0.72 + 0.42. Reverse delay starts within StopThresholdMph.

AccelerationCurveExponent_RaisingThisDoe.value: Raises this advanced numeric value; inspect its name and driving documentation before changing it.

AerodynamicDragCoefficient_RaisingThisDo.value: Raises this advanced numeric value; inspect its name and driving documentation before changing it.

BaseAlignResponsiveness_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes hover orientation align more quickly for every vehicle.

BaseNormalLateralGrip_RaisingThisDoes.value: Adds more normal cornering grip to every vehicle.

DownforceGripInfluence_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes Downforce add more grip as speed rises.

DownforceReference_RaisingThisDoes.value: Requires more Downforce stat to reach neutral high-speed grip.

HighSpeedGripMph_RaisingThisDoes.value: Delays the point where the full downforce grip contribution is reached.

HoverStabilityExponent_RaisingThisDoes.value: Widens hover-alignment differences between stability stats.

HoverStabilityReference_RaisingThisDoes.value: Requires more HoverStability stat to reach neutral alignment response.

LateralGripExponent_RaisingThisDoes.value: Widens cornering-grip differences between vehicle stats.

LateralGripMaxMultiplier_RaisingThisDoes.value: Raises maximum grip for high-stat vehicles.

LateralGripMinMultiplier_RaisingThisDoes.value: Improves the minimum grip available to low-stat vehicles.

LateralGripReference_RaisingThisDoes.value: Requires more LateralGrip stat to reach neutral cornering grip.

AutoHoldMph_RaisingThisDoes.value: Engages the stationary parking hold at a higher speed.

BaseBrakeDeceleration_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes braking stronger for every vehicle.

BrakeWeightExponent_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes vehicle weight influence braking more strongly.

BrakingForceExponent_RaisingThisDoes.value: Widens braking differences between low- and high-stat vehicles.

BrakingForceReference_RaisingThisDoes.value: Requires more BrakingForce stat to reach neutral braking performance.

CoastBaseDeceleration_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes an unpowered vehicle slow down more quickly at all speeds.

CoastSpeedCoefficient_RaisingThisDoes.value: Adds more coasting slowdown as speed increases.

ReverseCurveExponent_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes reverse acceleration fade more sharply near reverse top speed.

StopThresholdMph_RaisingThisDoes.value: Allows stopped/brake-to-reverse logic to engage at a higher speed.

ThrottleDeadzone_RaisingThisDoes.value: Requires more input before acceleration or braking registers.

BoostDurationExponent_RaisingThisDoes.value: Widens boost-duration differences between low- and high-stat vehicles.

BoostDurationMaxSeconds_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes the longest possible boost last longer.

BoostDurationMinSeconds_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes the shortest possible boost last longer.

BoostDurationReferenceSeconds_RaisingThi.value: Makes the reference boost charge last longer.

BoostEfficiencyTimingExponent_RaisingThi.value: Makes BoostEfficiency influence boost duration and recharge more strongly.

BoostRechargeDelayExponent_RaisingThisDo.value: Makes the vehicle recharge-delay stat affect the physical delay more strongly.

BoostRechargeDelayMaxSeconds_RaisingThis.value: Raises the longest delay before boost starts recharging.

BoostRechargeDelayMinSeconds_RaisingThis.value: Raises the shortest delay before boost starts recharging.

BoostRechargeExponent_RaisingThisDoes.value: Widens recharge-time differences between low- and high-stat vehicles.

BoostRechargeMaxSeconds_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes the slowest possible recharge take longer.

BoostRechargeMinSeconds_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes even the fastest possible recharge take longer.

BoostRechargeReferenceSeconds_RaisingThi.value: Makes the reference boost recharge take longer.

BaseDriftLateralGrip_RaisingThisDoes.value: Adds drift grip and reduces boat-like sideways sliding.

BaseDriftSideForce_RaisingThisDoes.value: Adds more sideways turning force while drifting.

BasePhysicalDriftControl_RaisingThisDoes.value: Increases the baseline drift turning authority for every vehicle.

DriftChargeExponent_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes DriftChargeRate change drift-charge speed more strongly.

DriftChargeReference_RaisingThisDoes.value: Requires more DriftChargeRate to reach neutral drift-charge speed.

DriftControlExponent_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes DriftControl affect turning and alignment more strongly.

DriftControlReference_RaisingThisDoes.value: Requires more DriftControl stat to reach neutral drift authority.

DriftEngineAssist_RaisingThisDoes.value: Adds more forward engine drive while acceleration is held in a drift.

DriftForwardDragBase_RaisingThisDoes.value: Removes more forward speed throughout a drift.

DriftForwardDragBlendExtra_RaisingThisDo.value: Adds more forward-speed loss as the drift reaches full blend.

DriftGripExponent_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes the DriftGrip stat affect remaining slide more strongly.

DriftGripReference_RaisingThisDoes.value: Requires more DriftGrip stat to reach neutral drift grip.

DriftMiniBoostAbsoluteMaxDurationSeconds.value: Raises the final safety cap for post-drift boost duration.

DriftMiniBoostAbsoluteMinDurationSeconds.value: Raises the absolute shortest post-drift boost duration.

DriftMiniBoostBaseMaxDurationSeconds_Rai.value: Makes a fully charged reference post-drift boost last longer before stat scaling.

DriftMiniBoostBaseMinDurationSeconds_Rai.value: Makes the shortest charge-based post-drift boost last longer.

DriftMiniBoostBoostDurationExponent_Rais.value: Widens post-drift duration differences between low- and high-duration boost modules.

DriftMiniBoostBoostDurationMaxMultiplier.value: Raises the duration multiplier ceiling for high-duration boost modules.

DriftMiniBoostBoostDurationMinMultiplier.value: Raises the duration floor for low-duration boost modules.

DriftMiniBoostBoostDurationReferenceSeco.value: Requires a higher mapped BoostDuration to reach the neutral duration multiplier.

DriftMiniBoostBoostForceExponent_Raising.value: Widens post-drift power differences between low- and high-force boost modules.

DriftMiniBoostBoostForceMaxMultiplier_Ra.value: Raises the post-drift power multiplier ceiling for high-force boost modules.

DriftMiniBoostBoostForceMinMultiplier_Ra.value: Raises the post-drift power floor for low-force boost modules.

DriftMiniBoostBoostForceReference_Raisin.value: Requires a higher BoostForce stat to reach the neutral post-drift force multiplier.

DriftMiniBoostChargeForFullReward_Raisin.value: Requires a longer or faster-charging drift to reach the full reward.

DriftMiniBoostExpiresDuringNormalBoost_R.value: Makes the post-drift reward expire instead of queueing behind normal boost when raised to 1.

DriftMiniBoostForceApplicationMultiplier.value: Raises the final physical force applied by every post-drift boost.

DriftMiniBoostMaxAcceleration_RaisingThi.value: Makes a fully charged reference post-drift boost accelerate harder.

DriftMiniBoostMinAcceleration_RaisingThi.value: Makes the weakest qualifying post-drift boost accelerate harder.

DriftMiniBoostMinimumCharge_RaisingThisD.value: Requires more earned drift charge before any post-drift reward is granted.

DriftMiniBoostRewardExponent_RaisingThis.value: Makes partially charged drifts produce less duration and force.

DriftMiniBoostStatScalingEnabled_Raising.value: Enables the new charge, BoostForce, and BoostDuration scaling when raised to 1; set 0 for the legacy reward formula.

DriftThrottleMinimum_RaisingThisDoes.value: Requires more accelerator input before drift drive and alignment activate.

DriftVelocityAlignmentMaxAcceleration_Ra.value: Allows a stronger maximum momentum-alignment force during a drift.

DriftVelocityAlignmentRate_RaisingThisDo.value: Pulls vehicle momentum around the direction of the corner more quickly.

PhysicalDriftControlExponent_RaisingThis.value: Widens physical drift-control differences between vehicle stats.

PhysicalDriftControlMaxMultiplier_Raisin.value: Raises maximum drift control on high-stat vehicles.

PhysicalDriftControlMinMultiplier_Raisin.value: Improves minimum drift control on low-stat vehicles.

BasePhysicalSteeringResponse_RaisingThis.value: Makes every vehicle turn more quickly.

SteeringResponseExponent_RaisingThisDoes.value: Widens the steering difference between low- and high-stat vehicles.

SteeringResponseMaxMultiplier_RaisingThi.value: Raises the maximum steering available to high-stat vehicles.

SteeringResponseMinMultiplier_RaisingThi.value: Improves the minimum steering available to low-stat vehicles.

SteeringResponseReference_RaisingThisDoe.value: Requires more SteeringResponse stat to reach neutral steering.

SteeringWeightInfluenceExponent_RaisingT.value: Makes weight influence steering and drift control more strongly.

SteeringWeightMaxMultiplier_RaisingThisD.value: Improves the best steering multiplier for light vehicles.

SteeringWeightMinMultiplier_RaisingThisD.value: Improves the worst steering multiplier for heavy vehicles.

AbsoluteTopSpeedSafetyMph_RaisingThisDoe.value: Raises the final safety ceiling, but only when PhysicalTopSpeedMaxMph is also high enough.

AerodynamicDragPerMphSquared_RaisingThis.value: Adds more speed-squared air resistance at high speed.

AerodynamicDragStatExponent_RaisingThisD.value: Makes the vehicle Drag stat influence air resistance more strongly.

BaseForwardAcceleration_RaisingThisDoes.value: Increases forward acceleration across the speed range.

DragReference_RaisingThisDoes.value: Requires a higher Drag stat to reach the neutral air-resistance point.

EngineOutputExponent_RaisingThisDoes.value: Widens acceleration differences between weak and powerful engines.

EngineOutputMaxMultiplier_RaisingThisDoe.value: Raises the maximum acceleration available to high-power vehicles.

EngineOutputMinMultiplier_RaisingThisDoe.value: Raises the minimum acceleration available to low-power vehicles.

EngineOutputReference_RaisingThisDoes.value: Requires more EngineOutput to reach the reference acceleration multiplier.

HighSpeedAccelerationExponent_RaisingThi.value: Makes acceleration fall away more sharply after the power band.

HighSpeedAccelerationFloor_RaisingThisDo.value: Leaves more engine pull available very near top speed.

LaunchAccelerationMultiplier_RaisingThis.value: Makes the initial launch below the ramp speed stronger.

LaunchEngineInfluence_RaisingThisDoes.value: Makes engine-power differences more noticeable during launch.

LaunchRampEndMph_RaisingThisDoes.value: Extends the softer launch section to a higher speed.

PhysicalTopSpeedAtReferenceMph_RaisingTh.value: Raises the physical top speed of every vehicle around the reference stat.

PhysicalTopSpeedExponent_RaisingThisDoes.value: Widens tier speed differences: below-reference vehicles become slower and above-reference vehicles become faster.

PhysicalTopSpeedMaxMph_RaisingThisDoes.value: Raises the normal configurable ceiling for mapped physical top speed.

PhysicalTopSpeedMinMph_RaisingThisDoes.value: Raises the lowest physical top speed the curve can produce.

PowerBandStartRatioHigh_RaisingThisDoes.value: Lets high-power vehicles retain strong pull closer to top speed.

PowerBandStartRatioLow_RaisingThisDoes.value: Lets low-power vehicles retain strong pull closer to top speed.

SoftLimiterStrength_RaisingThisDoes.value: Pushes the vehicle back under its forward or reverse speed limit more strongly.

TopSpeedRawReference_RaisingThisDoes.value: Reduces mapped physical speed for the same raw TopSpeed stat.

WeightAccelerationExponent_RaisingThisDo.value: Makes vehicle weight affect acceleration more strongly.

WeightAccelerationMaxMultiplier_RaisingT.value: Improves the best acceleration multiplier for light vehicles.

WeightAccelerationMinMultiplier_RaisingT.value: Improves the worst acceleration multiplier for heavy vehicles.

WeightReference_RaisingThisDoes.value: Moves the weight point that counts as neutral for acceleration and braking.

DriftMiniBoostNotes.value: When DriftMiniBoostRequiresAcceleration is true, releasing drift only grants mini-boost if throttle is above DriftMiniBoostAccelerationThreshold. ReverseMaxMph controls reverse top speed.

InputOwnedSteeringTurnBankNotes.value: Raw left/right input remains the sole bank owner. SteeringDriveMode restores original reverse yaw, retains forward mode while braking, and switches to forward immediately on forward throttle during a three-point turn.

SlopeHoverNotes.value: Fixes uphill/downhill hover-height drift by damping vertical velocity relative to expected slope-following vertical motion instead of raw world-Y velocity. ForceAlongGroundNormal is optional and off by default.

SpeedSteeringNotes.value: LowMultiplier boosts low-speed turning, HighMultiplier softens high-speed turning, CurveExponent controls how aggressively low-speed assist ramps in, ReverseSteeringMultiplier tunes reverse separately, BoostSteeringMultiplier stacks on top while normal boost or drift mini-boost is active.
